Method / Architecture: Classical Bayesian Retinex-style model using hyper-Laplacian priors on the reflectance component to better separate illumination from reflectance under underwater lighting.
Literature Review (Summary): Extends the authors' earlier Bayesian Retinex work with a more expressive (hyper-Laplacian, heavier-tailed) statistical prior for sharper detail recovery.

Title: URSCT-SESR: Reinforced Swin-Convolutional Transformer for Simultaneous Underwater Sensing and Enhancement/Super-Resolution
Method / Architecture: Hybrid Swin-Transformer + CNN backbone (URSCT) combined with a simultaneous enhancement-and-super-resolution (SESR) training scheme reinforced via task-specific objectives.
Literature Review (Summary): Merges Swin-style windowed self-attention with convolutional feature extraction specifically for the joint enhancement + super-resolution UIE setting popularized by SESR/Deep-SESR.
Paper Link: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS), 2022

Title: USUIR: Unsupervised Underwater Image Restoration
Method / Architecture: Fully unsupervised restoration framework — trains without ANY paired or synthetic ground-truth by decomposing the underwater formation model into reconstructible components using cycle-consistency style losses.
Literature Review (Summary): Notable for requiring zero reference images of any kind during training, addressing the ground-truth scarcity problem more aggressively than semi-supervised approaches.

An Underwater Image Vision Enhancement Algorithm Based on Contour Bougie Morphology (CBM)

Single Underwater Image Restoration by Contrastive Learning (CWR)

Underwater Image Co-enhancement with Correlation Feature Matching and Joint Learning (UICoE-Net)
Venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology 2021

Title: Underwater Image Enhancement based on Deep Learning and Image Formation Model (PhysicalNN)
A Novel Dark Channel Prior Guided Variational Framework for Underwater Image Restoration (UTV)
Method / Architecture: Variational optimization framework that extends the dark-channel-prior dehazing idea with a total-variation-style regularizer tailored to underwater scattering.
Literature Review (Summary): A classical, model-based restoration method offering an interpretable alternative to black-box deep models, often used as a physically-grounded baseline.
Paper Link: Journal of Visual Communication and Image Representation (JVCIR), 2020

Title: Fast Underwater Image Enhancement for Improved Visual Perception (FUnIE-GAN)
Method / Architecture: Conditional GAN (fully-convolutional generator + Markovian discriminator) optimized for real-time inference; introduces the EUVP dataset
Literature Review (Summary): A widely-used real-time GAN baseline for UIE; balances perceptual quality with fast inference suitable for onboard robot vision.
Paper Link: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2020, vol.5 no.2 pp.3227-3234

Title: HybridDetectionGAN: Perceptual Underwater Image Enhancement with Deep Learning and Physical Priors
Method / Architecture: GAN framework that combines a physical underwater imaging prior (transmission/backscatter estimation) with a learned adversarial refinement stage, and is jointly optimized alongside a detection-oriented loss.
Literature Review (Summary): Bridges physical-model-based and GAN-based UIE by using the physical prior to constrain the GAN's search space, improving stability versus purely data-driven GANs of the time.
Paper Link: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT), 2020

Title: L2UWE: A Framework for the Efficient Enhancement of Low-Light Underwater Images Using Local Contrast and Multi-Scale Fusion
Method / Architecture: Classical local-contrast + multi-scale fusion pipeline specifically tuned for LOW-LIGHT underwater scenes (e.g. deep water, night dives), rather than the more commonly studied color-cast/haze case.
Literature Review (Summary): Fills a gap most UIE benchmarks miss: severe low-light underwater conditions, using only classical image-fusion techniques (no training).

Title: Semantic Segmentation of Underwater Imagery: Dataset and Benchmark (SUIM)
Method / Architecture: Benchmark dataset + segmentation network (SUIM-Net) for underwater scenes, often used alongside enhancement pipelines
Literature Review (Summary): Provides a semantic segmentation benchmark specific to underwater imagery, commonly used to evaluate whether enhancement improves downstream scene understanding.

Title: SESR / Deep SESR: Simultaneous Enhancement and Super-Resolution of Underwater Imagery for Improved Visual Perception
Method / Architecture: Single network jointly performing enhancement and 2x/3x/4x super-resolution; introduces the UFO-120 dataset
Literature Review (Summary): Combines two typically-separate tasks (enhancement, super-resolution) into a single efficient model for real-time robotic perception underwater.

Title: Underwater Image Enhancement via Medium Transmission-Guided Multi-Color Space Embedding (Ucolor)
Method / Architecture: Multi-color-space (RGB, HSV, Lab) embedding network guided by a medium-transmission-based attention map
Literature Review (Summary): Fuses complementary information from multiple color spaces and uses estimated medium transmission to guide attention toward more degraded regions.
Paper Link: IEEE Transactions on Image Processing (TIP), 2021 (preprint circulated 2020)

Title: Underwater Scene Prior Inspired Deep Underwater Image and Video Enhancement (UWCNN)
Method / Architecture: Lightweight CNN trained directly on synthetic data generated per an underwater scene prior (10 water types), no need to estimate transmission/ambient light
Literature Review (Summary): Synthesizes training data using an underwater imaging physical model spanning multiple water types, letting a simple CNN learn enhancement end-to-end without explicit parameter estimation.

Title: UWGAN: Underwater GAN for Real-world Underwater Color Restoration and Dehazing
Method / Architecture: GAN-based color restoration and dehazing trained to generalize to real-world (unlabeled) underwater images
Literature Review (Summary): Compares against classical (UDCP, IBLA, Fusion) and GAN-based (UGAN, WaterGAN) baselines; focuses on real-world generalization rather than only synthetic benchmarks.

Title: All-In-One Underwater Image Enhancement using Domain-Adversarial Learning (DAL)
An Underwater Image Enhancement Benchmark Dataset and Beyond (WaterNet)
UWStereoNet: Unsupervised Learning for Depth Estimation and Color Correction of Underwater Stereo Imagery
Color Balance and Fusion for Underwater Image Enhancement
Method / Architecture: Classical (non-deep-learning) fusion approach: derives a white-balanced version and a contrast/sharpness-enhanced version of the input, then fuses them via multi-scale Laplacian pyramid blending guided by weight maps.
Literature Review (Summary): One of the most-cited classical UIE baselines; still used as a comparison method in nearly every modern UIE paper due to its simplicity and surprisingly strong visual results without any training data.

Title: Enhancing Underwater Imagery Using Generative Adversarial Networks (UGAN)
Method / Architecture: Conditional GAN (WGAN-GP based) trained on paired distorted/undistorted underwater images generated via CycleGAN
Literature Review (Summary): One of the first GAN-based UIE papers; introduces the paired 'Underwater ImageNet' training data (via CycleGAN-generated distortions) and shows GANs improve downstream feature-based diver tracking.

Title: Shallow-Water Image Enhancement Using Relative Global Histogram Stretching Based on Adaptive Parameter Acquisition
Method / Architecture: Relative Global Histogram Stretching (RGHS) — adaptively stretches each color channel's histogram based on automatically estimated water-type parameters, without any learning.
Literature Review (Summary): A lightweight, training-free classical method still commonly used as a fast baseline for shallow-water color-cast correction.

Title: WaterGAN: Unsupervised Generative Network to Enable Real-Time Color Correction of Monocular Underwater Images
Method / Architecture: Unsupervised GAN that models the underwater image formation process (attenuation + scattering) to generate synthetic underwater training pairs, then a color-correction network
Literature Review (Summary): Pioneering unsupervised approach: generates realistic synthetic underwater data by simulating the physical formation model, avoiding the need for real paired ground truth.
Paper Link: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2018 (journal version of 2017 conference work)
